nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Linear regression of ROI cortical thickness on predictors to derive norm-adjusted z scores.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: ROI thicknesses were regressed on age, gender, and site (only study 2 included site) in HCs to model the effects of normal aging, gender, and site. ... we regressed cortical ROIs on these variables in HCs.

nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Global mean cortical thickness and ROI thicknesses (22) were computed using FreeSurfer.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Predictors included age, gender/sex, site (study 2), global mean cortical thickness (in models with global adjustment), and ICV in sensitivity analyses.
